title: Does a 19-metre bogie-hearth furnace need separately supplied hearth plates?
summary: Optional hearth plates must be identified explicitly when comparing loading and supply scope. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s 19 m bogie-hearth furnace proposal dated 2 February 2023 records a 50 t-class loading arrangement, 12 heating zones and 6 roof circulation fans, while marking 30 mm heat-resistant steel hearth plates as a buyer option. Selecting or omitting them changes support, element protection and bottom heat-transfer checks; the difference cannot disappear from the base configuration.
